areas.description: A city that worships Janus, the Passage Titan who guides humanity, and the other Titans who control Fate. After the calamity, only the ruins of the temple remain.

markers.title: Marmoreal Market
markers.desc: The main area where the citizens of Okhema partake in daily activities. The tightly packed shops in this market provide for the daily lives of the residents. Here, they can perhaps enjoy a temporary respite from the troubles of Eschatos looming outside the city.
markers.image: Space Anchor Marmoreal Market.png

markers.title: Kephale Plaza
markers.desc: A plaza constructed to honor the miracles of Kephale. Many followers can be seen praying here... As well as numerous citizens wandering around with nothing better to do.
markers.image: Space Anchor Kephale Plaza.png

markers.title: Path of Parting
markers.desc: A path leading beyond the dawn. Follow the path to reach the fallen city of Janusopolis — a place now referred to as the Abyss of Fate.
markers.image: Space Anchor Path of Parting.png

markers.title: Hall of Respite
markers.desc: After enjoying the soothing bath, people gather here to taste the honey brew and delicacies blessed by Phagousa, enjoying a joyous banquet before Eschatos.
markers.image: Space Anchor Hall of Respite.png

markers.title: Overflowing Bath
markers.desc: The largest bath in the Palace that Phagousa once shared with the people, resulting in the bath water surging like waves. The lively atmosphere here makes you feel surging waves of emotion.
markers.image: Space Anchor Overflowing Bath.png

markers.title: Court of Seasons
markers.desc: It is said that each bath in the Marmoreal Palace possesses a different blessing, making the bather feel different from different "oceans"... In actual fact, only the temperatures of the baths are different.
markers.image: Space Anchor Court of Seasons.png

markers.title: Marmoreal Palace
markers.desc: The giant baths blessed by Phagousa. People gather here to enjoy the joys of banquets and honey brew, and to immerse themselves in the ever-flowing debate and laughter.

markers.title: Girl Once Known as "Mem?"
markers.desc: Mem vanished after saving you from the reverse flow of time. You stand before a tranquil village, where rush grass sways and golden wheat ripples in the wind. There, a girl named Cyrene awaits your very first meeting.

areas.name: Vortex of Genesis
areas.description: The starting point of the world, hidden by the waves. A grand sanctuary that houses the primal divinity of the Twelve Titans. It's also the promised land that will see the descent of the Miracle of Genesis, as prophesized by the oracles.

markers.desc: The spirit basin at the heart of the Vortex of Genesis is the sacred vessel for sealing the Coreflame. It seems to be home to a spirit that longs for ambrosia. Offering the collected Celestial Ambrosia into the basin and the echoes of the tides may bestow you with a gift in return...

markers.title: World Breeding Meridian

markers.desc: The dawn of Okhema has ended, and this long path connecting dawn and evernight has also been submerged in the burning twilight.
markers.image: Space Anchor Road of Sunset.png

markers.title: Mirage Cove
markers.desc: The unattended Court of Seasons has lost the meaning of its name, yet in the mist of the bath, the silhouettes of bustling guests still seem to linger.
markers.image: Space Anchor Mirage Cove.png

markers.title: Tranquil Waters
markers.desc: The spirit water is still, the dawn has withered, and the greatest bath of the Marmoreal Palace now rests in tranquil silence.
markers.image: Space Anchor Tranquil Waters.png

markers.title: Whispering Hall
markers.desc: The honey brew and delicacies blessed by Phagousa are no longer genuinely enjoyed by anyone. The feast before the end times is frozen in silent desolation.
markers.image: Space Anchor Whispering Hall.png

markers.title: Frostlight Bath Chamber
markers.desc: In the midst of the apocalypse, the baths blessed by Phagousa no longer host the joy of feasts and honey brew. With no one to tend to the water's temperature, the vast baths have become cold and desolate.
markers.image: Space Anchor Frostlight Bath Chamber.png

markers.title: Silent Night's Market
markers.desc: The once-bustling Marmoreal Market was evacuated after the apocalypse descended, with goods left scattered across the ground, untouched and forgotten.
markers.image: Space Anchor Silent Night's Market.png

markers.title: Sentinel Plaza
markers.desc: Through the efforts of the Holy City Guards, the once Kephale Square became a sanctuary for the people after the eternal day faded, as if the Throne of Worlds still watched over humanity.
markers.image: Space Anchor Sentinel Plaza.png

markers.title: Locufox Forest Backdoor
markers.desc: A place located between the thresholds of Locufox Forest and Foxsomn Tomb. Within the courtyard walls lies a forest of bamboo sprouting from bewildering stones. Upon these rocks exists a place of condolence for those in grief to expel their pain.

markers.title: Verdantia Terrace Entrance
markers.desc: The water-facing terrace entrance of Fyxestroll Garden. Craftsmen seized the opportunity to circulate the running waters through the confines of the park and let nature flourish in sprouts of bamboo and thickets of flora elegance, instilling the richness of rustic woodland upon the area.

markers.title: Swallowsong Pavilion Entrance
markers.desc: A pavilion for banquets and composing poetry in Fyxestroll Garden. In ancient times, those of literary virtue enjoyed coming to Swallowsong Pavilion to exchange cups of libations and engage in poetic construction, naming this place to be a "sanctum of wine and lyricality."

markers.title: Pavilion of Cessation Corridor
markers.desc: The outside of the Pavilion of Cessation forms a corridor decked with sittable sills between the pillars. This offers people a place to rest for a moment and enjoy the coolness or hide from the rain. Additionally, they may also direct their attention toward the Pavilion of Fragrance and appreciate ongoing operatic performances.
